title: Register for a Rental Bonds Online account (landlords)
summary: This page provides information for self-managing landlords on how to register for a Rental Bonds Online account.
intro:
NSW Fair Trading’s Rental Bonds Online is used by landlords, agents and tenants for rental bond money payments and refunds.

If you're a self-managing landlord, you must:
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Rental Bonds Online landlord/owner proof of identity and registration'
Proof of identity documents as listed on the form

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre.
instructions to activate your Rental Bonds Online account.

contact: For help with Rental Bonds Online:

more_info.text: Landlords cannot require a tenant to use Rental Bonds Online. Landlords who do can be fined $2,200.
For more information visit the NSW Fair Trading website – Rental Bonds Online for self-managing landlords.

faqs.a: NSW Fair Trading’s Rental Bonds Online is used by landlords, agents and tenants for rental bond money payments and refunds.

faqs.q: How do I register for a Rental Bonds Online account?
faqs.a: Self-managing landlords must select the 'Download PDF form' button, complete the form, and submit their application in person at a Service NSW Centre.
